domain: public synthetic 2D Chess Positions, not real camera
checkpoint_selection: validation full-board exact-match with confidence=0.9 and margin=0.25, then raw square accuracy
baseline_completion_rule: may stop at a saved epoch when validation full-board exact-match >=0.95 and raw square accuracy minus abstention rate >=0.99; otherwise at most 12 epochs/patience 4
format_comparison: same frozen test images for PT and ONNX after checkpoint selection
